- **Tauri 2.x** - Rust-based desktop framework
- **SQLite** - Local database via tauri-plugin-sql

## 🚨 Critical Rules

### DO ✅
- Use TypeScript strict mode (no `any`, proper null checks)
- Use Nanostores for global state
- Use Tailwind CSS for all styling
- Use Luxon for date/time operations
- Use path aliases (`@/components`, `@/lib`, etc.)
- Sign all generated log files with Ona signature
- Follow conventional commit messages
- Test changes before committing
- Update documentation when needed

### DON'T ❌
- Don't use `any` type (use `unknown` if needed)
- Don't use custom CSS files
- Don't use Context API for global state
- Don't use moment.js or date-fns
- Don't modify files in `shollu-old/` (reference only)
- Don't skip linting/formatting
- Don't commit without testing
- Don't introduce new patterns without discussion

## 🎨 Code Style

### TypeScript Example
```typescript
// ✅ Good
import { useStore } from '@nanostores/react';
import { $prayerTimes } from '@/stores/prayer-times';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface PrayerCardProps {
  className?: string;
  showSeconds?: boolean;
}

export default function PrayerCard({ 
  className, 
  showSeconds = false 
}: PrayerCardProps) {
  const times = useStore($prayerTimes);
  const now = DateTime.now();
  
  const formatTime = (time: string): string => {
    const dt = DateTime.fromFormat(time, 'HH:mm:ss');
    return showSeconds ? dt.toFormat('HH:mm:ss') : dt.toFormat('HH:mm');
  };
  
  return (
    <div className={cn('rounded-lg bg-white p-4 shadow-sm', className)}>
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
        {formatTime(times.fajr)}
      </h3>
    </div>
  );
}

// ❌ Bad
import React from 'react'; // Not needed
import './styles.css'; // Don't use custom CSS
import moment from 'moment'; // Don't use moment

function PrayerCard(props: any) { // Use proper types
  const [time, setTime] = React.useState(); // Use Nanostores
  
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 16 }}> {/* Use Tailwind */}
      <h3>{moment(props.time).format('HH:mm')}</h3>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Nanostores Example
```typescript
// Define store
import { map, computed } from 'nanostores';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

export const $prayerTimes = map<PrayerTimes>({
  date: DateTime.now().toISODate() || '',
  fajr: '',
  dhuhr: '',
  asr: '',
  maghrib: '',
  isha: '',
});

// Computed store
export const $nextPrayer = computed($prayerTimes, (times) => {
  // Calculate next prayer
  return 'dhuhr';
});

// Action
export function updatePrayerTimes(times: Partial<PrayerTimes>) {
  $prayerTimes.set({ ...$prayerTimes.get(), ...times });
}

// Use in component
import { useStore } from '@nanostores/react';
const times = useStore($prayerTimes);
```

### Code Comments
```typescript
// ✅ Good - Explains WHY
// Use Hanafi method for Asr calculation as per user preference
const asrTime = calculateAsr(date, latitude, longitude, 'hanafi');

// ❌ Bad - Explains WHAT (obvious from code)
// Calculate Asr time
const asrTime = calculateAsr(date, latitude, longitude, 'hanafi');
```

## 🔄 Git Workflow

### Commit Message Format
```
<type>: <subject>

<body>

Co-authored-by: Ona <no-reply@ona.com>
```

**Types:**
- `feat:` - New feature
- `fix:` - Bug fix
- `docs:` - Documentation changes
- `chore:` - Maintenance tasks
- `refactor:` - Code refactoring
- `test:` - Adding tests
- `style:` - Code style changes (formatting)

**Examples:**
```
feat: implement prayer time calculation engine

Add support for 5 calculation methods (MWL, ISNA, Egypt, Makkah, Karachi)
with both Standard and Hanafi Asr calculations.

Co-authored-by: Ona <no-reply@ona.com>
```

```
fix: correct Qibla direction calculation for southern hemisphere

The previous calculation didn't account for locations south of Mecca.
Updated algorithm to handle all latitudes correctly.

Co-authored-by: Ona <no-reply@ona.com>
```

## 🧪 Testing Checklist

Before committing, verify:
- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] ESLint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Code is formatted (`npm run format`)
- [ ] No console errors in browser
- [ ] Manual testing completed (if UI changes)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] Commit message follows conventions

```bash

npm run tauri:dev        # Start Tauri app (opens window)
npm run dev              # Start Vite dev server only

npm run lint             # Check for linting errors

npm run format           # Format code with Prettier

# Building

npm run tauri:build      # Build production app

# Rust (in src-tauri/)

cargo clippy             # Lint Rust code

cargo build              # Build debug
cargo build --release    # Build release
```

## 🆘 Common Issues

### Issue: TypeScript errors
**Solution:** Check types, use proper imports, avoid `any`

### Issue: Tailwind classes not working
**Solution:** Check `tailwind.config.js`, use `cn()` helper

### Issue: Store not updating
**Solution:** Use `.set()` method, check if using `.get()` correctly

### Issue: Luxon timezone issues
**Solution:** Always specify timezone, use `.setZone()`

### Issue: Build fails
**Solution:** Run `npm run lint`, check for TypeScript errors
